description:
Customize Windows 11/10 system font with 100% system coverage across UWP, Win32, WinUI 3, Electron, etc and safely restore with one click.


What's New in v6.0:
- Fixed font vertical spacing: Removed unwanted empty space above and below text on fonts like Google Sans and Inter. Fonts now align and render with proper line height.
- Redesigned UI: Updated the interface with new icons and a cleaner layout.
- Fixed default font leaks: Resolved issues where stock Windows fonts still appeared in certain system dialogs and legacy apps.
- Full font replacement support across all Latin, Cyrillic, and Greek languages.
- Smart Latin surgery for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean Windows editions.
